newsitem.title: UK: UK's Hampton Trust buys 15 mln stg property.
newsitem.headline: UK's Hampton Trust buys 15 mln stg property.

text.p: British property investment firm Hampton Trust Plc said on Monday it was planning to acquire a portfolio of properties from the PDFM group for 15.38 million stg.
The portfolio comprised six freehold and four heritable properties located across the United Kingdom totalling 415,000 square feet.
The present annual net rental income amounts to 1.38 million stg of which about 66 percent is attributable to leases which have five years or more to expire.
The initial yield from the property portfolio was 8.99 percent.

The consideration would be satisfied by a cash payment of 8.9 million stg to be satisfied from Hampton's existing cash resources. The balance will be met by issue of 18 million shares of five pence each at a price of 36 pence each.
Hampton's share price closed at 31 pence on Friday.
Hampton also said it was planning to sell its interest in Titan Resources NL, an Australian company involved in the exploration and production of gold and base metals.
The disposal will be effected by returning the Titan shares to Hampton Trust ordinary shareholders through a reduction of the company's ordinary share capital.
